info.title: API.SH: Nike
info.description: The Nike API from API.SH: public Nike data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Nike's search-box suggestions for the start of a query in a country store; without `q`, the popular searches the box opens with.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nike-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Start of a search (leave out for popular searches).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country store, e.g. US, GB, DE, FR, JP (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Nike's SNKRS launch calendar: upcoming releases (or the feed, or launches in stock) with each product's title, style code, price, release date and method, status, image and sizes with availability.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nike-new-releases

get.description:

get.description:
A Nike product's customer reviews: rating, title, text, author, date, fit (runs small, true to size, runs big), comfort, recommended, usual size, location, helpful votes, photos and Nike replies, with `raw`. The rating counts per star and the review topics with counts come with the list; `total` is the review count. Sort by recent or oldest. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nike-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Style code (six characters, e.g. `CW2288`) or style-colour (`CW2288-111`), as in a nike.com product link.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A nike.com product link instead of `id`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words instead of `id`: the reviews of the first search result.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Store used for the `q` search (default US).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

reviews.title: Totally satisfied
reviews.text: I bought this pair of sneaker for my teenage son and he loved it.
reviews.author: lydia G

reviews.title: Good stuff
reviews.text: Good shoes for walking and running

get.description:
Products on Nike for keywords or a category path, per country store (US, GB, DE, FR, IT, NL, JP), with sort. Each product: style-colour id, group key, name, subtitle, type, price, full price, currency, discount, colour, badge, promotions, customizable flag, link, image and every colourway (id, colour, price, link, image). `total` is the site's count. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Filter by the store's own facets: `facets=1` adds `facets` (gender, colour, size, price band, brand, sport, height, width ... with each option's id, name, count and selected flag) and `attribute_ids`; pass option ids back as `filters`. `gender` and `sale` are shortcuts.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nike-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A nike.com listing path such as /w/mens-shoes-nik1zy7ok, alone or with `q`.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: US (default), GB, DE, FR, IT, NL, JP.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

parameters.name: facets
parameters.description: 1 to add the filter groups with counts (`facets`).

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Comma-separated option ids from `facets[].options[].id` (all must match), e.g. a colour and a size.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Nike's store locator: Nike-owned and partner stores near a point, with id, store number, name, type and concept, address, position, phone, time zone, opening date, opening hours by day, special hours, in-store services and image.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/nike-stores

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
